New Digital Resources Kit for Clients
Based on recent requests for a central resource for promotional resources, we're excited to introduce our new Digital Resources Kit <[[https://flywire.foleon.com/guides/flywire-digital-resource-kit/cover/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>.
This kit contains promotional recommendations, templates and assets (How to Pay flyers, banners, buttons, videos, QR codes and more) that can be used to promote Flywire as part of your institution's digital communications strategy across email, social media and web. Real Clients.
